narrative.overview: A field instrument operated at night: the mountain supplies the physical metaphor while every DOM surface behaves like calibrated measurement equipment. Client view is the quiet overlook; advisor view is the survey station.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black stage with rare, state-bearing color.
Condensed humanist copy paired with truly monospaced data.
Hairlines and tonal layers instead of ambient card shadows.
One explicit decision path: solvency to model disagreement to robust spending.
Accessible tables and sentences are peers of the WebGPU scene.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color must encode model, state, cohort, or interaction.

rules.name: The Red Means Failure Rule
rules.body: Ember Red is forbidden for emphasis, branding, or hover decoration.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Human interpretation uses Barlow; machine-measured facts use IBM Plex Mono.

rules.name: The Survey Glass Rule
rules.body: Translucency is allowed only when it preserves spatial context over the mountain.

dos: Do lead from the client question to exact advisor evidence without changing the underlying result.
Do reserve saturated color for state-bearing information.
Do show every WebGPU fact through semantic DOM evidence too.
donts: Don't build a generic fintech KPI dashboard of interchangeable cards.
Don't use trading-terminal cosplay or ornamental neon.
Don't gamify retirement or turn a stochastic result into a guarantee.
Don't bury model limitations or failure magnitude behind a polished score.
Don't use generic AI patterns such as gradient text, excessive rounded cards, or repeated eyebrows.
